summary: Referral System v2 backend testing complete. 37/37 tests pass (100%). All referral endpoints verified working correctly including code generation, dashboard, popup eligibility, cron verification, landing page, and anti-abuse protection.

minor.issue: Returns 500 when called without JSON body (should return 422 for validation error)

referral_code_endpoint.GET /api/referral/code: VERIFIED - Returns referral_code (BB-XXXXXX format) and referral_link
referral_code_endpoint.idempotent: VERIFIED - Returns same code on multiple calls

popup_eligibility_endpoint.GET /api/referral/popup-eligible: VERIFIED - Returns eligible boolean with reason

dismiss_popup_endpoint.POST /api/referral/dismiss-popup: VERIFIED - Records dismissal and returns ok

landing_page_endpoint.valid_code: VERIFIED - Shows invitation message and code

referral_status_flow.cron_verifies_active: VERIFIED - After 14 days if still active
referral_status_flow.cron_rejects_inactive: VERIFIED - After 14 days if not active

reward_logic.2_verified_equals_1_free_month: VERIFIED - Reward issued when 2 referrals verified
reward_logic.progress_tracking: VERIFIED - Dashboard shows progress toward next reward

critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY CONCERN: Apple auth has a fallback that trusts client-provided user_id when token verification fails. In production, invalid tokens should be rejected to prevent account creation with arbitrary user_ids.
Webhook endpoint returns 500 instead of 422 when called without JSON body - minor issue but should be fixed for proper error handling.
All referral system v2 features are implemented correctly and working as specified.

success_rate.frontend: N/A (backend-only testing requested - this is a React Native Expo app)

seed_data_creation: Demo account (demo_reviewer_account) used for testing. Has referral code BB-257527. Test users created during integration tests are cleaned up after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Referral System v2 fully verified. Collections used: referral_codes, referral_links, referral_rewards, referral_popup_dismissals. Status flow: account_created → verification_pending → verified/rejected. Reward logic: 2 verified referrals = 1 free month in ledger. Popup has 7-day cooldown after dismissal. Cron endpoint processes 14-day verification. Demo user has code BB-257527 and tier 'booked-out' (paid). Apple auth has fallback that trusts client user_id - security concern for production.

rca_of_the_issue.finding: All referral system v2 endpoints are working correctly
rca_of_the_issue.security_note: Apple auth fallback trusts client-provided user_id when token verification fails. This is intentional for development but should be reviewed for production security.
